product.description: The Monoprice™ Folding Ceiling TV Mount is perfect for mounting 10" to 40" televisions* weighing up to 66 pounds. The mounting arm swings down for TV viewing and swings up when you need that space for something else. The arm features a strong locking mechanism that prevents it from swinging down unless it is physically released.        *The minimum and maximum display sizes are only approximations.
